every_position_composed.reason: Site 2 keeps its explanatory text cards and 3D labels synced across all scroll positions (including frames 4 and 7), whereas Site 1 drops the text card completely in frames 4 and 7, leaving awkward unannotated transitional states.

explains_the_project.reason: While both sites share the same 3D factory metaphor across frames 1 to 9, Site 2 maintains continuous pairing between the text explanation and the 3D machine states in frames 4 and 7 so the visualization never loses context.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites render the exact same 3D models, materials, lighting, and gridded floor across frames 1 through 9.

type_and_layout.reason: Both sites use the same clean typography and left-hand card layout, though Site 2 avoids the blank left-hand layout gaps seen in Site 1's frames 4 and 7 (despite minor overlapping in frame 4).

overall.reason: Site 2 delivers a more cohesive scroll experience by keeping the explanatory UI cards consistently visible alongside the 3D visualization in every frame rather than dropping out mid-scroll.
